alt_text: Headline: Why AI agents fail at AAA games. The page features an illustration related to GameHorizon Suite: Multi-Horizon Data and Evaluation in Gameplay.
Measuring Multi-Horizon Gameplay. The paper introduces GameHorizon, a unified framework using 5,000 hours of human gameplay across 21 titles.
Prior game benchmarks suffer from narrow coverage and reproducibility issues. Datasets focus on simple mini-games, and methods use small, hard-to-reproduce samples.
The annotator pipeline processes raw traces through segmentation, dynamic programming, and question generation to create standardized benchmark clips and questions.
Proprietary model GPT-6-Astra leads with 80.2% accuracy, while UMMs lag behind the mean of 64.7%.
